module_summary: Direct-mapped 16-line write-through cache: a 5-state FSM latches a CPU request, compares tag/valid arrays, serves read hits from the data array, fills on read miss and writes through to memory, updating the line on write hit.

anchors.name: n12_921
anchors.why: Idle/lookup/write-through/miss-fill/done controller driving array writes, memory requests and responses.

anchors.name: n31_888
anchors.why: Data array of 16 words, filled on miss and updated on write hit.

anchors.name: n39_a69
anchors.why: Tag array per line, written on miss fill, compared during lookup.

anchors.name: n29_9d9
anchors.why: Per-line valid bits, set when a line is filled.

anchors.name: n17_859
anchors.why: Hit: valid and tag match; steers lookup to done vs miss and gates write-hit update.

anchors.name: n27_004
anchors.why: CPU request valid; in idle latches address, data and rw.

anchors.name: n8_7ee
anchors.why: CPU request address providing tag and index.

anchors.name: n13_d2c
anchors.why: CPU read data from response register (hit data or filled memory word).

anchors.name: n36_7c3
anchors.why: Response valid pulse in the done state.

anchors.name: n1_748
anchors.why: Read/write select latched with the request; write takes the write-through path.

anchors.name: n33_76d
anchors.why: Latched request address; supplies index/tag and the memory address.

anchors.name: n3_06e
anchors.why: Memory request asserted in miss-fill and write-through states.

anchors.name: n4_85c
anchors.why: Memory acknowledge completing fill or write-through, advancing FSM.

anchors.name: n14_e12
anchors.why: Memory read data written into the data array and response register on fill.

anchors.name: n0_398
anchors.why: Request ready, high while FSM idle.

anchors.name: n34_97e
anchors.why: CPU write data latched for write-through.

anchors.name: n35_aa0
anchors.why: Latched write data, sent to memory and written into array on hit.

anchors.name: n28_2be
anchors.why: Latched write flag choosing write-through path from lookup.

anchors.name: n19_55e
anchors.why: Response data register loaded from array hit, memory fill, or write data.

anchors.name: n2_598
anchors.why: Line index from latched address addressing tag, data and valid arrays.

anchors.name: n25_790
anchors.why: Memory write enable, asserted in write-through state.

anchors.name: n38_84e
anchors.why: Busy indication while a request is in progress.

groups.name: cache_controller
groups.description: Request FSM and its decoded ready/valid/busy outputs.

groups.name: cache_arrays
groups.description: Data, tag and valid arrays for 16 direct-mapped lines.

groups.name: hit_logic
groups.description: Index/tag split of latched address and tag compare.

groups.name: request_latch
groups.description: Latched address, write data and response data held across the operation.

groups.name: memory_port
groups.description: Downstream memory request/ack bus for fills and write-through.
